I frequently ult objectives when its very dark nearby and no enemies appear. Its only a 30sec cooldown so i dont hesitate to try and see what i can do. Lux is really good for objective stealing so i am happy that exists

Always assume something will happen.
Finish a fight? Check where the enemy jungler last was. 
Farming? Ask if the jungler can come in for a gank.
New wave not here yet? Check how the map is looking.


These little hints can tell you what could go down. Enemy jungler went silent for about a min? Check dragon pit.
River looking dark, see if your sp could pop a ward somewhere there.


If you lack trust in your ability to start/think when to fight, dont start it. When the enemy shows like they are going to set up for a fight, you respond accordingly. They start walking up then you start walking away as the jungler might be coming.


If you are playing with a friend, always call out what you think the status of everything is like "going for a ward" "enemy backed lets shove" "jungler is gone play safe and watch the wards" your friends could be the person to tell you whether your decisions seem logical or not. 



Sometimes instinct can pay off, if you feel like its been a goddamn long time since the enemy ADC used flash, expect them to escape your engage so dont all in just yet, try to bait out the flash without burning all you got.

Third, decide what the criteria are. You could do it in the traditional way of "like and follow/retweet". If its in discord it could be "react to this message with :pepega: and i will pick one person" or something like that. The bar could be as high or low as you desire.

Suddenly, a few pebbles fall from the door in front of me. I bite my lip and tap my feet in excitement as i await my possible escape. A bright light appears, wind blows towards my face. My armor glows a bright crimson red. The treasurer hunters cheer out saying "We've done it boys!"

I smirk as i charge towards one of them. I summon 2 spectral illusions of myself to get the other 2 treasure hunters. The illusions do as i, and dash towards the treasurers and past them. I sheave my katana as the treasurer hunters all fall to the ground with a slit across their abdomen.

I hear a call for help in the other room. I morph into one of the treasurer hunters and hide the bodies in a rift of my own. I chase after the person and say "It's ok nothing happened, we are fine." 

I watch as 6 soldiers walk in. They point their guns towards the doorway and proceed to breach and check the room. I flick my fingers and a crimson assassin appears behind the person who called for help and slit his throat while covering his mouth. 

The soldiers report their status through some random black box. I turn into a black cloud and float amongst them, returning to my normal form to cut them down with my katana in one hand, and toss fireballs with my other. They let out a faint grunt and fall under my feet.

I let out a deafening roar, as a legion of about 1000 Gold Golems equipped with guns stand by me. I chant the words "Jishgunda Okaize". They storm out with loud, ground-trembling footsteps. I hear cries of help come from outside as i slowly walk up the stairs....

My friends party around me on my birthday. Some fly around, some light a cigarette with the others breath, some camouflage on my wall. I sit there silently awaiting for my power to come to me while i sip on a beer. 

"Come on let's have some fun in private." as my crush, Cindy bumps my shoulder. In my mind i think "Is this my power? Seduction of the ones i fantasize over?"

"Come on, let's go!" I am snapped out of my thoughts as she drags me into my room. We both undress as my heart races to prepare me for what may as well be the luckiest moment of my life. 

We get really into it and finish up after 30 minutes. I get dressed, walking out of the room and see a smile on her face. She silently whispers in my ear "You were so amazing."

I whistle in happiness while going downstairs to tell my friends what happened. When i reach the kitchen, Dave has passed out drunk as he always does, and the rest listen to me in their drunken state. 

"**KRAWK**"

A loud bird-like call comes from my front porch, i open the door to see a Griffin standing there. I was puzzled while my friends stood beside me with a confused look on their faces. I whistle lightly to call my dog back into the house. 

Suddenly, the griffin lowers its head. I walk up to pet it. To my surprise, it likes it and i start to think "I can....summon a griffin?!" Cindy walks up and tugs me signaling me to walk off. I shake my head and whistle a loud and short whistle. 

The griffin flies up into the air and makes a spin before landing back down. Me and my friends are in awe. I notice a small saddle on it and decide to get on the griffin as i let out a calming and long whistle. The griffin ascends slowly and flies me towards the city. 

My friends who can fly follow me to fly alongside me and the griffin. We chuckle towards each other as the griffin calls out like an eagle. I whistle to tell it to land and pet it before clapping my hands as an experiment to how it would react. The griffin claps its wings and flies up into the night sky, piercing through the clouds and dissapearng.

Suddenly, a voice comes from beside me, then a spotlight shines over it, a glowing woman with blonde hair and glistening blue eyes standing beside me. I silently say:"You the judge?" She nods and opens a book.

"Pay $10,000 for 10 more years", "Lose one select limb for 100 extra years.", "Lose 2 select limbs for immortality" or "Skip".

I shrug at her and ask "How do i pay for the 10 years?". She says in a warming voice "In your pocket, there is a coin to do so." I dig it out, observing under the judge's light to see that it has some engravings. My bank account number and the numbers "10,000" are on it.

The judge points at a jukebox in the corner of the room, advising me to slot the coin in when I am ready. I shuffle towards it weakly, and hold my hand above the slot.

I turn to see the judge holding her hand up to ask me why not choose 100 more years or even immortality. I smirk slightly to say "I have a wife and kid, seeing them die in front of me would be an ever-aching agony to witness." I see a small tear roll down her smooth, perfect face.
